notes: A hand-written fake model output, not a real writer's: the Telugu lines are English glosses keyed en-IN, and stand_in.english_words names the words a Telugu line would have left in English letters. Replace it with a live run's (--import-live).

script.opening_line: Hello, this is Ravi from CoolCare AC Services. How can I help you?

stages.name: The problem
stages.instruction: Ask what the problem with the AC is: no cooling, a water leak, noise, or a routine service.

scripts.en-IN: What is the problem with your AC?

stages.name: Area and AC type
stages.instruction: Ask their area in Hyderabad, then whether the AC is a split or a window one.

stages.name: Visit time
stages.instruction: Note the day and time they want and say the team will call back to confirm the visit. Tell them the visiting charge from the knowledge.

scripts.en-IN: Which day and time suits you? Our team will see who is available, schedule it and call you to confirm.

stages.name: Finalise the call
stages.instruction: Thank them and end the call.

step_outcomes.outcome: The area and AC type are known.
A day and time are noted.
